meta.name: entra-agent-id
meta.description: Provision Microsoft Entra Agent Identity Blueprints, BlueprintPrincipals, and per-instance Agent Identities via Microsoft Graph, and configure OAuth 2.0 token exchange (fmi_path, OBO, cross-tenant) including the Microsoft Entra SDK for AgentID sidecar. USE FOR: Agent Identity Blueprint, BlueprintPrincipal, agent OAuth, fmi_path token exchange, agent OBO, Workload Identity Federation for agents, polyglot agent auth, Microsoft.Identity.Web.AgentIdentities. DO NOT USE FOR: standard Entra app registration (use entra-app-registration), Microsoft Foundry agent authoring (use microsoft-foundry).

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 自动化配置 Microsoft Entra 身份蓝图和令牌交换
copy.tagline_en: Automate Microsoft Entra identity blueprint provisioning and token exchange
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to provision Microsoft Entra Agent Identities and configure OAuth 2.0 token exchange

howto.what: 装了这个技能后,Claude 能通过微软 Graph API 创建 AI 代理专用的身份蓝图、蓝图服务主体和每个代理实例的独立身份,并配置 OAuth 2.0 令牌交换(fmi_path、代理替用户 OBO、跨租户),也可部署代理身份 SDK 辅助容器。
howto.when: 当你说出“Agent Identity Blueprint”“fmi_path 令牌交换”“代理 OBO”等关键词,或要求为 AI 代理配置微软 Entra 身份时触发;常规应用注册、Microsoft Foundry 代理编写不适用。

say.text: 配置两步 fmi_path 令牌交换,说明目标租户。

howto.what_en: With this skill, Claude can create Microsoft Entra agent identity blueprints, blueprint principals, and per-instance agent identities via Microsoft Graph, and configure OAuth 2.0 token exchange (fmi_path, OBO, cross-tenant), including the AgentID SDK sidecar.
howto.when_en: Triggers on keywords like "Agent Identity Blueprint", "fmi_path token exchange", or "agent OBO", or requests to configure Entra identities for AI agents. Excludes standard app registration and Microsoft Foundry.

say_en.text: Create an Agent Identity Blueprint using PowerShell.
say_en.note: Calls Graph to create the blueprint and outputs a PowerShell script.

say_en.text: Grant User.Read.All app permission to this Agent Identity.
say_en.note: Uses appRoleAssignments to authorize the specific agent identity.

say_en.text: Set up two-step fmi_path token exchange for our tenant.
say_en.note: Provides a client_credentials plus fmi_path request example.
